description: Audit and optimize Local AI Hub preprocessing. Preserve incremental watcher behavior; never clear every project's cache as a side effect of a major-change heuristic; hash changed candidates and reuse content-addressed file, module, project, and RAG caches; invalidate only stale dependent results.

acceptance_criteria: Trace actual ProjectPreprocessor.PHASES, scheduler, cursor, activity, GPU admission and resource-limit paths before editing.

Schedule active projects across base phases, then RAG/files, then optional phases; schedule inactive projects across the same layers at lower priority; diagnostics remains separately disabled by default.

Foreground agent access refreshes only the matching canonical absolute root's durable activity timestamp; background/internal work never refreshes it; rolling 24-hour expiry and immediate reactivation work.
New foreground activity raises next selection priority; bounded batches rotate projects; active arrivals and high layers cannot starve inactive projects or lower layers.
Restart resumes durable checkpoints without repeating completed work; content changes invalidate only stale dependents and task deduplication remains correct.
Cache identity includes canonical root, normalized path, content snapshot, and parser/index config version for parser-dependent data.
A metadata-only fast path may skip hashing, but the hash must match the current source snapshot before index publication.
Content invalidation fans out only to affected lexical, RAG, symbol, contextual-card and dependent cache entries.
Concurrent edits produce bounded retry or explicit stale status; they cannot cause an unbounded needs_hash or requeue loop.
HUB-005 acceptance test uses two roots with the same filename, a no-watcher edit, restart, concurrent edit, and verifies search/RAG return only current root content.

Every batch reuses existing path, security, writer-lease, admission, concurrency, batch, CPU/RAM, time, queue, model and GPU controls; limits are never exceeded; preemption/defer never publishes incomplete model/GPU results.

Focused tests cover layering, activity/background exclusion, 24-hour expiry/reactivation, per-root isolation, fairness/starvation, batching, restart/checkpoint, all resource limits and unavailable/preempted resume.
Update relevant docs and INSTALL_PROMPT/UPDATE_PROMPT; report no performance claim without measurement.
task_preprocessing_audit.blocker: Existing task requires authenticated command_execution_record.v2 receipts; this host session has native command execution but no attached app terminal receipt channel.
task_preprocessing_audit.description: Implement fair layered multi-project preprocessing and the roadmap HUB-005 cache/index freshness contract. Foreground activity per canonical absolute root defines active projects over a rolling 24-hour window. Background preprocessing must not refresh activity. Preserve phase dependencies, durable cursors/checkpoints, cache invalidation, deduplication, path confinement, writer leases, admission and all configured limits. Active projects traverse base phases together, then RAG/files, then optional phases; inactive projects receive the same layers at lower priority with anti-starvation. For HUB-005, key cache identity by canonical repo root, normalized path, content snapshot and parser/index configuration where required; invalidate only stale dependent lexical, RAG, symbol and card data; stale races must retry boundedly or report stale, never spin. Diagnostics stays separate and disabled by default. No live DB refresh, provider/model-route change, API or data-format change.
task_preprocessing_audit.next_action: Implement and verify HUB-005 no-watcher content changes, cross-root isolation, restart and concurrent-edit behavior within the existing preprocessing task.
task_preprocessing_audit.title: End-to-end preprocessing optimization and cache freshness
